newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle shares dip after profit data.
newsitem.headline: Nestle shares dip after profit data.

text.p: Nestle SA shares opened easier and remained under pressure in early trading after the company reported first-half 1996 group net profit rose 20 percent but forecast profit growth rates would slow in the second half.

"The numbers were good, and the 20 percent growth is very good," one dealer said. "But the trading margin went down and they said profit growth would slow," he added. Sales pressure was coming primarily from British investors, he said.
Shares opened at 1,417 francs, down from the previous close at 1,423, and then slipped to around 1,408 before steadying.
